content.text: In the Philippines, digital creators face a critical barrier: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-explained-digital-creators-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-digital-products-how-one-creator|USDT Payment]] processors like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or unreliable. This leaves you unable to sell your digital products—ebooks, courses, templates—to a global audience. Google Apps Script offers a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-explained-digital-creators|sovereign]] solution. It’s not a workaround; it’s base-layer infrastructure. Paired with GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto processing, it creates a stack you own entirely. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. This post explains how Google Apps Script automates your commerce pipeline, from payment verification to product delivery, without depending on third-party platforms. By the end, you’ll understand how to deploy this architecture today, reclaiming control over your digital commerce.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a JavaScript-based platform that automates tasks within Google Workspace. For digital commerce, it acts as the backend logic layer, handling payment verification, order storage, and product delivery. Unlike platforms like Gumroad or Paddle, it doesn’t require monthly fees or KYC. You write scripts that trigger when a payment is confirmed via NOWPayments’ webhook. The script updates a Google Sheet with the order details, generates a secure download link from Google Drive, and sends a delivery email via Gmail. The entire process is automatic, instant, and runs on infrastructure you control. This matters because it eliminates reliance on payment processors that reject you. It’s not a patch; it’s a permanent architecture. You own the code, the data, and the process. No one can shut it down or charge you recurring fees. This is sovereignty in digital commerce.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The pipeline starts with NOWPayments. When a buyer sends cryptocurrency, NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain and fires a webhook to your Google Apps Script. The script parses the webhook data, logs the order in a Google Sheet, and generates a time-limited, signed URL for the product file stored in Google Drive. It then sends a delivery email via Gmail or Resend, containing the download link. Every step is serverless and cost-free. Google Apps Script runs on Google’s infrastructure, and Google Sheets/Drive provide storage and file hosting. NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee per transaction, with no additional costs. The system is stateless: no databases to manage, no servers to maintain. It scales automatically with Google’s resources. You deploy the script once, and it handles every transaction without intervention. This is how you build a commerce stack that operates without permission.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software and cannot use Stripe, PayPal, or local gateways, this is your solution. It’s also for creators who refuse to rent their infrastructure. With this stack, you own the entire pipeline. No platform can suspend your account, change your fees, or dictate your terms. It’s designed to be simple enough for non-developers to deploy but powerful enough to handle hundreds of transactions daily. You don’t need to understand blockchain, webhooks, or server management. The scripts and templates are pre-built. You configure them once, and they run indefinitely. This is for creators who prioritize sovereignty over convenience, who choose to own their infrastructure instead of renting it.
Google Apps Script automates your entire commerce pipeline without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of five core components: 1. **GitHub Pages** or **Cloudflare Pages** for hosting your storefront (free). 2. **Google Apps Script** for backend logic, triggered by NOWPayments webhooks. 3. **Google Sheets** for order storage, with each row representing a transaction. 4. **Google Drive** for storing product files, with signed URLs for secure delivery. 5. **NOWPayments** for cryptocurrency processing, with automatic webhook integration. Optional components include **Resend** for transactional emails and **Cloudflare Workers** for advanced logic. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all templates and blueprints for these components. Each piece is free or low-cost, with no hidden fees. The system is modular: you can replace Google Sheets with Supabase or Gmail with Resend as your needs grow. The key is that every component is open, interoperable, and under your control. This is how you build a commerce stack that cannot be taken from you.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all scripts, templates, and step-by-step guides. Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure NOWPayments to send webhooks to your Google Apps Script. Copy the provided script into your Google Sheets project, linking it to your order sheet and product files in Google Drive. Test the pipeline by sending a test payment through NOWPayments. Once confirmed, the script should log the order, generate a download link, and send the delivery email. Finally, publish your storefront and start selling. The entire process takes less than 48 hours. You now have a fully operational commerce stack that you own outright. No platform fees. No geographic restrictions. No one can shut it down. This is how you take control of your digital commerce.
Does the Google Apps Script still work?

Google Apps Script automates your digital commerce pipeline by handling payment verification, order storage, and product delivery. It integrates with NOWPayments to process cryptocurrency transactions, logs orders in Google Sheets, generates secure download links from Google Drive, and sends delivery emails via Gmail. The entire system runs on free, serverless infrastructure, eliminating the need for Stripe, PayPal, or other restricted platforms. You own the code, the data, and the process, ensuring sovereignty and permanence in your commerce operations.
NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. 2. Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages using the provided template. 3. Set up a NOWPayments account and configure it to send webhooks to your Google Apps Script. 4. Copy the provided Google Apps Script into your Google Sheets project, linking it to your order sheet and product files in Google Drive. 5. Test the pipeline by sending a test payment through NOWPayments. Verify that the order is logged, the download link is generated, and the delivery email is sent. 6. Publish your storefront and start selling your digital products globally.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes pre-built scripts and templates. You only need to configure them, not write code from scratch. The guides are step-by-step, designed for non-developers.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and stablecoins on BSC, Solana, and TRON networks for low transaction fees.
How secure is the file delivery process?
The script generates time-limited, signed URLs for each download. This ensures only the buyer can access the file, and the link expires after a set time, preventing unauthorized sharing.
Can I scale this beyond a few products?
Yes. The architecture is modular and stateless. You can add more products to Google Drive, expand order storage with Supabase, and handle higher volumes with Cloudflare Workers if needed.
What happens if Google Apps Script fails?
The script is designed to be idempotent, meaning it can safely retry failed operations. NOWPayments’ webhook can be replayed, ensuring no orders are lost. You can also monitor script logs for errors.
